title: Adopt verified SpecSync 6.1.1 approval review learning and archive lifecycle for 3md
description: Adopt verified SpecSync 6.1.1 approval review learning and archive lifecycle for 3md
no_spec_change_rationale: Operations-only CI and agent governance migration; product APIs and canonical module contracts remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Exact 6.1.1 writer and action inputs; required meaningful source/test/governance coverage; genuine human definition approval before implementation; separate current scoped human review of the implementation; actual product tests distinct from canonical checks and active-workspace audit; same-PR finalize/archive before merge; read prior lessons and record observed findings with evidence and limits. Preserve all stronger existing checks, risk thresholds, signer policies, archives and unrelated work. A non-mutating lifecycle guard fails for a wrong engine, disabled policy, uncovered meaningful path or unfinished active workspace and passes a clean finalized fixture. No fabricated approvals or inherited-history repairs. Human review and finalization remain pending until they actually happen.
